name: security-audit

# Security Audit Skill

Use this skill whenever generating sensitive code (auth, data handling, API endpoints).

1. **Review**: Read `.github/instructions/security-protocols.md` and run the full **Security Audit Checklist** (Rules #1–#10) against the code.
2. **Report**: Use the **Output Format** defined in that file to report findings and fixes.
Note: Skills are loaded on-demand when relevant to the task.
